title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - API/Console/Dedicated/Private
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Lydia Park (eng lead)
Date: 2026-03-03 (tentative)
Location: Zoom / quick sync
Goal: Align on immediate priorities for API/Console + Dedicated/Private rollout items, unblock engineering work, and agree on action items for next two weeks.

Top context (what I want to surface)
- Q1 priorities: latency SLOs for hosted API, console rollout for route-level observability, Dedicated capacity autoscale policy pilot, Private (VPC) onboarding checklist for two POCs.
- Recent incidents: 2026-02-18 degraded KV-cache warm path increased tail latency for a subset of models (INF-3421). Eng investigating root cause.
- Signals: cost per 1k tokens trending up 6% MoM in hosted; customer asks for clearer quantization guidance in console; Dedicated commits pipeline delayed by infra quotas.

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick sync (5 min) - how are you, any blockers on capacity?
2) INF-3421 status (5 min) - repro, mitigation, timeline to fix and rollback plan
3) Console rollout: observability widgets & rollout plan (7 min)
   - Need to decide: enable per-route traces by default? opt-in vs opt-out for heavy workloads
   - UX ask: add token-cost breakdown in trace header (design PR: github:redwood-inference/console#421)
4) Dedicated autoscale pilot (7 min)
   - Pilot with two customers next week; confirm autoscale policy defaults and burst settings
   - Capacity reservations: who owns infra quotas for pilot (Marcus?)
5) Private onboarding checklist (3 min)
   - Two POCs: BankCo (strict KMS) and HealthApp (on-prem). Final items to close before next call
6) Quick wrap + action items (3 min)

Talking points / prompts for Lydia
- INF-3421: Do we have a tentative root cause? Is it a model/kernel scheduling issue or a KV-cache logic regression? If we need a rollback, are all teams aligned on the fallback variant?
- Console traces: If we enable per-route traces by default, what's the perf/cost impact on our hosted control plane? Can we gate by account tier?
- Autoscale pilot: What metrics should we watch during pilot (latency p95, 99, queue depth, cost per token)? Who will run the on-call rotation during pilot windows?
- Private POCs: Are there any outstanding compliance blockers (e.g., FedRAMP-like items) that require legal/product escalation?

Notes to self (raw)
- Mention customer feedback about confusing "quantization profile" labels in console. Offer to do a small guided doc + in-console tooltip.
- Ask Lydia if we can carve out 2 FTE-weeks from serving-runtime to help validate kernel selection for public models (helps INF-3421).
- Confirm with infra if Dedicated pilot needs dedicated VLAN or just reserved instances in the cloud tenant.

Unresolved questions to bring up
- Who signs off on per-route trace defaults? (Product + SRE?)
- Timeline expectation for INF-3421 bugfix vs rollback (2 days vs 7 days?)
- Is there appetite to make "cost per token" a first-class metric in console dashboards this quarter?

Proposed action items (owner / due)
- Lydia: confirm root cause hypothesis for INF-3421 and ETA for hotfix (owner: Lydia / due: 2026-03-05)
- Omar: draft short tooltip copy for quantization profiles + share in #console-ux (owner: Omar / due: 2026-03-04)
- Marcus: confirm infra quota and VLAN requirements for Dedicated pilot (owner: Marcus Li / due: 2026-03-04)
- Priya: schedule pilot kickoff with two customers and send runbook (owner: Priya Shah / due: 2026-03-06)
- Eng/Product: decision on per-route traces default (owner: Lydia + Omar / due: 2026-03-10)

Follow-up items (post-meeting)
- Update INF-3421 Jira with root cause notes and attach repro doc + perf graphs. Link to traces and waveform capture.
- If rollback chosen: sequence + customer-facing note template (I should draft).
- Console UX: prioritize quantization tooltip + token-cost header in next sprint; add to roadmap board.

Quick checklist to bring to meeting
- Latest INF-3421 logs (have link)
- Pilot runbook draft (uploaded to Confluence)
- Console design mock screenshots (open PR link)
- POC contact names for BankCo & HealthApp

Scratch ideas (not for meeting unless Lydia asks)
- A lightweight default "economy" profile that reduces perf by small amount but saves 20% cost — show as toggle in console. Could be a good default for lower tiers.
- Add a per-route anomaly alert that triggers when token-cost per minute spikes > 40% vs baseline (tie to cost monitoring).

End notes: keep the meeting tight; prioritize unblocking INF-3421 and pilot capacity. If Lydia is overloaded, surface the rollback path as the first option so product can communicate to customers quickly.

Links I may paste in meeting:
- INF-3421: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421
- Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/421
- Roadmap page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PLATFORM/pages/Prod+Roadmap+2026
